description.zh: 查询伸缩活动创建时间的结束时间戳。单位为毫秒。
description.en: The end timestamp for querying the creation time of scaling activities. The unit is milliseconds.

description.zh:
实例付费类型枚举值：
- ONDEMAND: 按量付费实例
- SPOT: 竞价实例
默认为null代表全选
举例: ["ONDEMAND", "SPOT"]
description.en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:

- ONDEMAND: Pay-as-you-go instance.

- SPOT: Spot instance.The default value is null, which means all billing methods are selected.Example: \["ONDEMAND", "SPOT"]

description.zh: 一次获取的最大记录数。
description.en: The maximum number of records to return in a single request.

description.zh: 标记当前开始读取的位置。
description.en: The token that marks the position from which the query starts.

description.zh: 伸缩活动状态。数组元数个数N的取值范围：1~20。
description.en: The status of the scaling activity. The number of elements in the array can range from 1 to 20.

description.zh:
伸缩活动类型。取值范围：
- SCALE_OUT：扩容。
- SCALE_IN：缩容。
description.en:
The type of the scaling activity. Valid values:

- SCALE\_OUT: Scale-out.

- SCALE\_IN: Scale-in.
The name of the scaling rule.

description.zh: 查询伸缩活动创建时间的开始时间戳。单位为毫秒。
description.en: The start timestamp for querying the creation time of scaling activities. The unit is milliseconds.
